name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
description: Performance-based hands-on certification demonstrating competence in Kubernetes cluster architecture, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 120 minutes.

domains.name: Cluster Architecture, Installation & Configuration
domains.description: Domain 1 (25%): Manage RBAC, use Kubeadm to install a basic cluster, manage highly available Kubernetes cluster, implement etcd backup and restore.

domains.name: Workloads & Scheduling
domains.description: Domain 2 (15%): Understand deployments and how to perform rolling updates, use ConfigMaps and Secrets, manage pod resource limits and scheduling.

domains.name: Services & Networking
domains.description: Domain 3 (20%): Understand host networking configuration, know how to use Ingress controllers and Ingress resources, configure and use CoreDNS.

domains.name: Storage
domains.description: Domain 4 (10%): Understand storage classes and persistent volume claims, configure volume access modes and reclaim policies.

domains.name: Troubleshooting
domains.description: Domain 5 (30%): Troubleshoot cluster components, cluster worker nodes, networking, and application failure scenarios.
